---
title: "Main analysis: region x time with expert intercept"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Religious groups in Southwest Asia, Europe, Africa and East Asia, without eHRAF and Pulotu, start year from 3000
BCE to 1500 CE (`-3000 <= year_from < 1500`), any time span. Conflicting answers (both "Yes" and "No" for the same
question and entry) are left out. Same sample and models as `10_region_time.Rmd`, with two changes:

- **Expert intercept.** Every model has a random intercept per expert, `(1 | expert)`, so an expert's entries count
  as related rather than independent (`12_region_time_experts.Rmd`; reasoning in the methods draft). Region
  intercepts and slopes then describe a typical expert. The curves are averaged over experts, so they are on the
  same scale as the observed shares.
- **Grouped questions.** Two sets of child questions are combined ("Yes" if any answered question in the set is
  "Yes", otherwise "No"; as in `11_region_time_grouped.Rmd`):
  - **murder out-group** (monitoring): murder other religions, murder other polities
  - **elite ties** (supreme high god): is monarch fused, is monarch manifestation, is kin to elites, other elite loyalty

  Entries that answer only some questions of a set are kept; the table under "Data" counts them.

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (`main_<model>_*`; delete them to
refit), figures in `fig/main/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(loo)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/main/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/main"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
region_colors <- c("Southwest Asia" = "#2a78d6", "Europe" = "#eb6834", "Africa" = "#1baf7a", "East Asia" = "#eda100",
                   "average" = "#52514e")
pooled_labels <- c(average = "average of region slopes", common = "common slope", no_region = "no region")
pooled_colors <- c("average of region slopes" = "#1a1a1a", "common slope" = "#8a63d2", "no region" = "#a3a29b")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500

# child questions combined into one ("Yes" if any answered question in the set is "Yes")
groups <- list(
  "murder out-group" = c("murder other religions", "murder other polities"),
  "elite ties" = c("is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty")
)
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_window <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll == "group",
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max
  ) |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000)

# conflicting answers (Yes and No for the same entry and question; weight < 1) are left out
conflicting <- d_window |> filter(weight < 1) |> distinct(entry_id, entry_name, region, question_short)
d <- d_window |> filter(weight == 1)

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in 4_baseline.Rmd), before grouping
topic_items <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_items, d |> filter(family != "parent") |> distinct(question_short) |> pull()))

# child questions after grouping: each set takes the place of its first question
items <- enframe(groups, name = "group", value = "question_short") |> unnest(question_short)
group_of <- setNames(items$group, items$question_short)  # question -> its set
topic_order <- unique(coalesce(unname(group_of[topic_items]), topic_items))
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

# child questions as answered; grouped sets collapsed to one answer per entry
children <- d |> filter(question_short %in% topic_items, !inferred)
grouped <- children |>
  filter(question_short %in% names(group_of)) |>
  mutate(group = unname(group_of[question_short])) |>
  group_by(question_short = group, family, entry_id, entry_name, expert, region, year_from, time) |>
  summarise(answer_value = as.integer(any(answer_value == 1)), n_items = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(complete = n_items == lengths(groups)[question_short])

# samples (one model per question in each)
sets <- list(
  parent = d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of), # as answered (no "No" inferred for the supreme high god since 2026-11-23)
  conditional = bind_rows(
    children |> filter(!question_short %in% names(group_of)),
    grouped |> select(-n_items, -complete)
  )
)
runs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "parent", question = unname(parent_of)),
  tibble(set = "conditional", question = topic_order)
)

questions <- bind_rows(sets) |> distinct(family, question_short)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))
```

Groups per region and experts in the window (any question):

```{r data_regions}
d_window |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(entries = n_distinct(entry_id), experts = n_distinct(expert))
```

Left out (conflicting answers, entry and question):

```{r data_conflicting}
conflicting
```

Grouped questions: entries, share "Yes", entries that answered only some questions of the set (partial), and
partial entries coded "No" (all answered questions "No"; uncertain):

```{r data_grouped}
grouped |>
  group_by(question = question_short) |>
  summarise(entries = n(), share_yes = round(mean(answer_value), 2), partial = sum(!complete),
            partial_no = sum(!complete & answer_value == 0))
```

Entries per question and region, and experts with at least two entries (they carry most of the information on the
expert SD):

```{r data_questions}
bind_rows(sets) |>
  group_by(question = question_short) |>
  mutate(experts_2plus = sum(table(expert) >= 2)) |>
  group_by(question, experts_2plus, region) |>
  summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  relocate(experts_2plus, .after = last_col()) |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Models and priors

```{r model}
models <- list(
  region_time = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + (1 | expert)),
  common = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + time + (1 | expert)),
  no_region = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | expert))
)

# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
region_priors <- reduce(
  map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)),
  c,
  .init = prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
)
sd_prior <- prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd")  # half-normal on the expert SD
priors <- list(
  region_time = c(region_priors, sd_prior),
  common = c(region_priors, sd_prior),
  no_region = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"), prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"), sd_prior)
)
```

`0 + Intercept` is the brms way of not centering the predictors, so the intercept prior of the no-region model
is at 0 CE, as for the region intercepts.

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- imap(models, function(formula, model) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = sets$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors[[model]],
                       chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(model, set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/main_%s_%s_%s.rds", model, set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(sets[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(model = names(models), runs) |>
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(model, set, question), fit_question))
fits_rt <- filter(fits, model == "region_time")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b|sd)_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per model and set
diagnostics |>
  group_by(model, set) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            divergences = sum(divergences), .groups = "drop")

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Estimates

```{r estimates}
summarise_slope <- function(value) {
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975), p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

# region x time model: region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

add_panels <- function(est) {
  est |>
    left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
    mutate(
      panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
      question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions))
    )
}

# (b) slopes per region (and their average)
estimates <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    region_slopes(fit) |> group_by(region) |> reframe(summarise_slope(value))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels() |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c(regions, "average")))

# (a) pooled slopes: average of the region slopes, common slope, no region
pooled <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map2(fit, model, function(fit, model) {
    value <- if (model == "region_time") {
      filter(region_slopes(fit), region == "average")$value
    } else {
      as_draws_df(fit, variable = "b_time")$b_time
    }
    summarise_slope(value)
  })) |>
  select(model, set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  mutate(estimate = factor(pooled_labels[if_else(model == "region_time", "average", model)], levels = pooled_labels)) |>
  add_panels()
```

Slopes are changes in log-odds per 1,000 years for a typical expert (expert intercept 0). Their sign and the
probability of a positive slope (`p_positive`) are the same on every scale: log-odds per year or per 1,000 years,
odds ratios, and the expert-averaged probability curves below (per draw, the curves rise exactly when the slope is
positive). Magnitudes are larger than on the expert-averaged scale, increasingly so for questions with a large
expert SD.

## Slopes table

Region x time model, per question: average of the four region slopes and each region's slope, as mean [95%
interval], with the probability of a positive average slope; and the expert SD (log-odds).

```{r slopes_table}
fmt <- function(mean, lower, upper) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean, lower, upper)
expert_sd <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(sd = map(fit, function(fit) {
    v <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "sd_expert__Intercept")$sd_expert__Intercept
    tibble(sd_mean = mean(v), sd_lower = quantile(v, 0.025), sd_upper = quantile(v, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, sd) |>
  unnest(sd)

slopes_table <- estimates |>
  mutate(value = fmt(mean, lower, upper)) |>
  select(question, region, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = value) |>
  left_join(filter(estimates, region == "average") |> select(question, p_positive), by = "question") |>
  left_join(expert_sd |> transmute(question, expert_sd = fmt(sd_mean, sd_lower, sd_upper)), by = "question") |>
  select(question, average, p_positive, all_of(regions), expert_sd) |>
  mutate(p_positive = round(p_positive, 3)) |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions))
print(slopes_table, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## Pooled slopes (a)

Pooled change in log-odds per 1,000 years (mean and 95% interval): average of the four region slopes (main
estimate), common slope (region intercepts, one shared slope), and no region (one slope, regions ignored).

```{r pooled, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 11}
p_pooled <- ggplot(pooled, aes(mean, question, colour = estimate, group = fct_rev(estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pooled_colors) +
  labs(x = "Pooled time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_pooled, "slopes_pooled", 8, 11)
```

## Slopes per region (b)

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years within each region (mean and 95% interval), and the average of the four
region slopes (grey). Panels: parent questions, monitoring children and supreme high god children (as answered).
The three pooled estimates are compared in "Pooled slopes (a)" above.

```{r slopes, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 12}
p_slopes <- ggplot(estimates, aes(mean, question, colour = region, group = fct_rev(region))) +  # top to bottom in legend order
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colors, breaks = c(regions, "average")) +
  labs(x = "Time slope within region (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 9, 12)
```

## Expert SD

Posterior of the expert SD per question (mean and 95% interval), region x time model. Dashed: median and 95%
quantile of the half-normal(0, 1) prior. A posterior close to the prior means the data say little about it.

```{r expert_sd, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 8}
p_sd <- expert_sd |>
  add_panels() |>
  ggplot(aes(sd_mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = qnorm(c(0.75, 0.975)), colour = "grey60", linetype = "22") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = sd_lower, xmax = sd_upper), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Expert SD (log-odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_sd, "expert_sd", 7, 8)
```

## Do the regions need their own slopes?

Leave-one-out comparison (expected log predictive density, elpd) of the common-slope and no-region models
against the region x time model, per question. Negative: worse than region x time; a difference of less than
about 2 standard errors is not a clear difference.

With an expert intercept, entries by experts who coded only that entry have their own intercept, which makes
PSIS-LOO less reliable for them; `high_k` counts observations with Pareto k > 0.7 in the region x time model. If
there are many, a cross-validation that leaves out whole experts (`kfold` grouped by expert) is the safer
comparison.

```{r loo, warning = FALSE}
# elpd of model a minus elpd of the region x time model b, as "diff (se)", from the pointwise values (as
# loo_compare does; its row names are no longer the model names in loo >= 2.10, so they cannot be used for the sign)
elpd_vs <- function(a, b) {
  d <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", sum(d), sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
}

# one core: forking for each of the small fits can exhaust processes ("unable to fork"), and gains nothing
fits |>
  mutate(loo = map(fit, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1))) |>
  select(model, set, question, loo) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = loo) |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    common_vs_region_time = map2_chr(common, region_time, elpd_vs),
    no_region_vs_region_time = map2_chr(no_region, region_time, elpd_vs),
    high_k = map_int(region_time, ~ sum(pareto_k_values(.x) > 0.7))
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Curves over time

One panel per question (parent question first), all four regions together. All curves are averaged over experts:
per posterior draw, P(yes) is the average of logit⁻¹(η + σ·z) over a grid of standard-normal quantiles z, with η
the linear predictor without the expert intercept and σ the expert SD. They are therefore on the same scale as the
observed shares.

- **Overall** (black line, grey band: 95% interval): the "typical region", η = ᾱ + β̄·time with ᾱ and β̄ the
  averages of the four region intercepts and slopes (per draw), averaged over experts. Its direction is the sign
  of the pooled slope reported above; it is flatter than β̄ alone would suggest.
- **Regions** (coloured lines): posterior mean of the region x time model (η = α_region + β_region·time, averaged
  over experts), drawn over the region's data range for that question (first to last start year); dashed where the
  500-year rolling window has fewer than 10 entries.
- **Data** (points): share yes per region in 500-year bins of start year (3000-2500 BCE, ..., 1000-1500 CE; lower
  edge included), size = number of entries; the four regions are shifted slightly around the bin midpoint so they
  do not overlap. Black-outlined points at the midpoint: all four regions pooled (share of all entries in the bin,
  so regions with more entries count more, unlike the overall curve).

```{r curves}
years <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 50)
answers <- bind_rows(sets, .id = "set") |> select(set, question = question_short, region, entry_id, year_from, answer_value)

# P(yes) averaged over experts: per draw (row of eta), mean of logit^-1(eta + sigma * z) over standard-normal quantiles z
z <- qnorm(ppoints(25))
expert_average <- function(eta, sigma) Reduce(`+`, lapply(z, function(zk) plogis(eta + sigma * zk))) / length(z)

# per fit: region intercepts and slopes (draws x regions, in region order) and the expert SD
curve_draws <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit) |> as_tibble()
  list(
    a = as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key))]),
    b = as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key), ":time")]),
    sigma = draws$sd_expert__Intercept
  )
}
eta_grid <- function(a, b) outer(a, rep(1, length(years))) + outer(b, years / 1000)  # draws x years

curves <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(cd = map(fit, curve_draws))

# overall curve: average region intercept and slope per draw, averaged over experts
overall_curves <- curves |>
  mutate(curve = map(cd, function(cd) {
    p <- expert_average(eta_grid(rowMeans(cd$a), rowMeans(cd$b)), cd$sigma)
    tibble(year = years, mean = colMeans(p), lo95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

# entries per region in 500-year rolling windows of start year (centred every 50 years)
rolling <- map_dfr(years, function(centre) {
  answers |>
    filter(year_from >= centre - 250, year_from < centre + 250) |>
    group_by(set, question, region) |>
    summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(year = centre)
})

# region curves (posterior mean, averaged over experts) within each region's data range, solid where the rolling
# window has at least 10 entries
data_range <- answers |>
  group_by(set, question, region) |>
  summarise(from = floor(min(year_from) / 50) * 50, to = ceiling(max(year_from) / 50) * 50, .groups = "drop")
region_lines <- curves |>
  mutate(curve = map(cd, function(cd) {
    map_dfr(seq_along(regions), function(r) {
      p <- expert_average(eta_grid(cd$a[, r], cd$b[, r]), cd$sigma)
      tibble(region = factor(regions[r], levels = regions), year = years, mean = colMeans(p))
    })
  })) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve) |>
  inner_join(data_range, by = c("set", "question", "region")) |>
  filter(year >= from, year <= to) |>
  left_join(rolling, by = c("set", "question", "region", "year")) |>
  mutate(solid = if_else(replace_na(n, 0) >= 10, mean, NA_real_))

# observed share per region in 500-year bins of start year
bin_edges <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 500)
offsets <- setNames(c(-75, -25, 25, 75), regions)
binned <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, region, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250 + offsets[as.character(region)])
binned_pooled <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250)

together_colors <- c(region_colors[regions], overall = "black")
together_plot <- function(questions_, ncol = 6) {
  keep <- function(x) filter(x, question %in% questions_) |> mutate(question = factor(question, levels = questions_))
  lines <- keep(region_lines)
  overall <- keep(overall_curves)
  ggplot(mapping = aes(year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = overall, aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned), aes(y = share, colour = region, size = n), alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = mean, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "22") +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = solid, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = overall, aes(y = mean, colour = "overall"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned_pooled), aes(y = share, size = n), shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", stroke = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ question, ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = together_colors, breaks = names(together_colors), labels = c(regions, "overall (typical region)")) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(year_min, year_max, by = 1000)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(year_min, year_max)) +
    labs(x = "Year (start year)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, size = "entries") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
}

monitoring_questions <- c(parent_of[["monitoring"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "monitoring")$question_short))
shg_questions <- c(parent_of[["shg"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "shg")$question_short))
```

```{r}
fit_unquestionably <- fits_rt |> filter(question == "is unquestionably good") |> pull(fit) |> pluck(1)
summary(fit_unquestionably)
```

```{r}
# average of the four region slopes, as one row (same as the average computed from the draws above)
hypothesis(fit_unquestionably, "(regionSouthwestAsia:time + regionEurope:time + regionAfrica:time + regionEastAsia:time) / 4 = 0",
           alpha = 0.05)
```

Alternative coding of the same model: average line plus region deviations. The region contrasts are orthonormal
and sum to zero, so `Intercept` is the average intercept and `time` the average slope. The priors are matched
to the main model (the average of four independent normal(0, 1) slopes is normal(0, 0.5); the deviations are then
independent normal(0, 1)), so the posterior is the same as above. Not saved.

```{r}
d_alt <- fit_unquestionably$data  # same data as the main fit
helmert <- contr.helmert(4)
contr_orthonormal <- sweep(helmert, 2, sqrt(colSums(helmert^2)), "/")  # columns sum to 0 and have length 1
contrasts(d_alt$region) <- contr_orthonormal
contr_orthonormal  # rows: Southwest Asia, Europe, Africa, East Asia

priors_alt <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.75), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"), # average of four normal(0, 1.5) intercepts
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "time"),       # average of four normal(0, 1) slopes
  set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = paste0("region", 1:3)),
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", coef = paste0("time:region", 1:3)),
  sd_prior
)
fit_alt <- brm(
  answer_value ~ 0 + Intercept + time + region + region:time + (1 | expert),
  data = d_alt, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors_alt,
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
)
```

```{r}

summary(fit_alt)
```


```{r}
# back from the contrasts to the four region slopes: slope = average + contrasts %*% deviations
draws_alt <- as_draws_df(fit_alt)
slopes_alt <- draws_alt$b_time + as.matrix(draws_alt[paste0("b_time:region", 1:3)]) %*% t(contr_orthonormal)
colnames(slopes_alt) <- regions
draws_main <- as_draws_df(fit_unquestionably)
tibble(
  region = c(regions, "average"),
  main = c(map_dbl(names(region_key), ~ mean(draws_main[[paste0("b_region", .x, ":time")]])),
           hypothesis(fit_unquestionably, "(regionSouthwestAsia:time + regionEurope:time + regionAfrica:time + regionEastAsia:time) / 4 = 0")$hypothesis$Estimate),
  alternative = c(colMeans(slopes_alt), mean(draws_alt$b_time))
)
```
